about: Acceptance corpus for the clinic allergy reading (bioagent.clinic.allergy). Each case gives a record, the prescribed herbs ("pack": every herb of the clinic pack) and the expected outcome per herb: stop (an allergy issue of severity stop), block (no stop, at least one allergy issue of severity block) or none (no allergy issue); a herb not listed in expect expects none. codes pins the issue code where given; has and lacks are substrings of the herb's messages. nit marks a form outside the acceptance criteria (a name no table holds, a rare miswriting), kept to document the limit. silent lists records that give nothing for any herb of the pack. intake lists allergy fields and whether the intake reads them as asked.

sources.r6 review round 1 (d087468): the first adversarial review of the reworked reading (its report, r6_result.json history[0], is not in the repository); each repro there is a case here
sources.review6 scripts: the review scripts deny, deny2, en, fn1-fn3, fp, fp2, labels and assess
sources.C1 common form: acceptance criterion C1: no silent miss in the common record forms
sources.C3 common corpus: acceptance criterion C3: no noise on the common corpus
sources.r7 review round 1 (03a822b): the review of the reading that scans every table name and reads the record twice (fix-up round 1); each repro there is a case here
sources.r7 review round 2 (b989f7d): the review of the narrative, line-break and tolerance reading (fix-up round 2): each repro there is a case here
